additional_config_fields.label: AWS Access Key ID
additional_config_fields.help: The AWS Access Key ID generated for your CrowdStrike FDR feed.

additional_config_fields.label: AWS Secret Key
additional_config_fields.help: The AWS Secret Key generated for your CrowdStrike FDR feed.

additional_config_fields.label: SQS Queue URL
additional_config_fields.help: The SQS Queue URL generated for your CrowdStrike FDR feed, in the form https://sqs.<region>.amazonaws.com/<account-id>/<queue-name>. Datadog reads the AWS region from this URL.

additional_config_fields.label: S3 Bucket
additional_config_fields.help: The bucket name or access point alias from your FDR feed's S3 path, without s3:// or the trailing path. For example, cs-<name>-cannon-<id>-s3alias.
